blocks.text: Product Description               Bring home the excitement of a real kitchen with the Melissa & Doug Stainless Steel Pots & Pans. This 8-piece set of toy kitchen accessories includes a colander, pot with lid, two pans, two wooden utensils, and a metal storage rack — everything young chefs need for cooking up hours of screen-free fun. The generously sized stainless steel play cookware is polished to a brilliant shine and built with riveted handles for durability parents will appreciate. Kids can sauté pretend play toys, boil pasta, simmer soup, then store their toddler kitchen playset on the included rack when sensory play is done for the day. For more thrilling role play, combine this with the Melissa and Doug ice cream set, a toy vending machine & a kids kitchen playset to create the ultimate pretend play world! For 35+ years, Melissa and Doug has crafted imaginative preschool toys and durable wooden toys built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from a life-sized grocery store playset to a play kitchen playset and play food to serve plush toys & puppets, to costumes, arts & crafts, and road trip activities for kids. It’s the kind of kid-powered play that builds independence and confidence!                  From the Manufacturer               From classic wooden toys to crafts, pretend play, and games, Melissa & Doug products provide a launch pad to ignite imagination and a sense of wonder in all children so they can discover themselves, their passions, and their purpose.

Since the company’s founding more than 25 years ago, Melissa & Doug has consistently delivered innovative products that inspire open-ended thinking, encourage kids to see new possibilities, and offer Countless Ways to Play. It’s part of a bigger vision to Take Back Childhood. Because by giving children a true childhood with the space and freedom to explore their world, we give them a path to realizing their full potential!

items.value: When buying a birthday gift & holiday gifts for kids, or rewarding little milestones, celebrate the moments that matter with Melissa and Doug toys for boys & girls

items.value: Melissa & Doug inspires kid-powered play with its learning toys for kids, baby & toddler toys, puzzles, games, building toys & stuffed animals, dolls, & even a doll house
